fields.summary: TC-857-01: Data Pull Pipeline Runs Successfully When create-cr Setting Is Omitted (Optional)

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-857

Precondition: The data pull pipeline has been updated so that the create-cr setting is optional. When deploying the pipeline to QA environment, the create-cr setting can be omitted without causing pipeline failures.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Trigger the data pull pipeline deployment to QA with the create-cr setting intentionally omitted from the pipeline config
Pipeline config: create-cr setting absent/null. All other required settings present.
Pipeline deployment initiates without immediately failing due to the missing create-cr setting
Verify the pipeline runs all stages successfully when create-cr is absent
Pipeline execution log with create-cr omitted
All pipeline stages complete successfully - no failure due to missing create-cr setting
Verify the pipeline still functions correctly when create-cr is provided (optional but functional when present)
Pipeline config with create-cr=true provided
Pipeline runs successfully with create-cr present and executes the CR creation step when specified
Verify the data pull operation completes and data is pulled from the source to the target environment
Target QA environment data store after pipeline run without create-cr
Data is successfully pulled to QA environment - the omission of create-cr does not affect the data pull itself
Verify no pipeline errors or warnings are generated when create-cr is omitted
Pipeline execution log after run without create-cr
Pipeline log shows clean execution with no errors or warnings about missing create-cr setting
